description: Retry a Studio generation that failed, keeping the same content id. RPC-backed. Prefer this over deleting and regenerating: that mints a new id and invalidates every reference you were holding. The artifact goes back to generating; poll list_content for the outcome. A retry can fail again on Google’s side.

content_id.description: The failed artifact’s id, as list_content reports it.

name: retry_content

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
